name: Mythic Cheetah
body:
MYTHIC CHEETAH
CR 3/MR 1

This large, sleek feline has a golden coat spotted with black. Its long and powerful legs are obviously capable of great speed.

XP 800
N Medium animal (mythic)
Init +9; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+4 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 27 (3d8+14)
Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.; sprintma
Melee bite +6 (1d6+3 plus trip), 2 claws +6 (1d3+3)
Special Attacks mythic power (1/day, surge ++1d6), pouncema

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 19, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +2; CMB +5; CMD 19 (23 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +8, Perception +5, Stealth +8 (+12 in tall grass); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in tall grass

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Sprint (Ex)

Once per hour, a cheetah can move at 10 times its normal speed (500 feet) when it makes a charge. When a mythic cheetah sprints, it benefits from the effects of blur, as per the spell, until the beginning of its next turn.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These swift felines are capable of prodigious sprints to run down prey, though they lack the endurance to keep up that pace for long. They are spotted like leopards and can even climb trees, though not as skillfully as their cousins, and they prefer to prowl the flat savannahs looking for prey they can isolate and chase. A cheetah’s forelimbs are longer than the those of other big cats, though they lack sharp retractable claws.
